name: Bevy
summary: Free, open-source, data-driven game engine in Rust built on an entity component system (ECS).
description: Games are plain Rust code using Bevy's ECS, with 2D and 3D rendering. Agents can inspect and change a running app through the Bevy Remote Protocol (BRP, the `bevy_remote` crate), which is what community MCP servers such as bevy_brp_mcp use. Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Latest release v0.20.1 (Oct 2026).
